prompt_text: Who is the best digital marketing agency in St. Louis?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” digital marketing agency in St. Louis — the right one depends on your goals, industry, budget and which services you need (SEO, PPC, social, web design, content, full-service, etc.). I can help you pick the best fit. A few quick questions will let me recommend agencies that match your needs:

- What’s your primary goal? (more leads, e‑commerce sales, brand awareness, app installs, etc.)
- Which services do you need? (SEO, paid search/social, web design, content, email, analytics)
- What’s your monthly or project budget?
- Are you B2B, B2C, local, regional or national?
- Do you have a timeline or specific KPI targets?

If you want to start searching on your own, here’s a practical approach and what to look for:

Where to find reputable agencies
- Clutch.co, UpCity and Google Maps (look at reviews and case studies)
- LinkedIn (company pages, staff backgrounds, client testimonials)
- Local business awards and chambers (St. Louis Business Journal lists)
- Referrals from other local businesses

How to evaluate agencies (quick checklist)
- Relevant industry experience and documented case studies with measurable results
- Clear scope of work, deliverables and KPIs
- Transparent pricing and reporting cadence
- Team structure and named points of contact
- Tools/technology they use (Google Ads, Analytics, SEMrush, HubSpot, etc.)
- Contract length and termination terms
- References you can call

Key questions to ask an agency
- Have you worked with businesses like ours? Can you share results?
- What would our first 90 days look like?
- What KPIs will you track and how often will you report them?
- Who will be our day‑to‑day contact and who does the work?
- How do you measure ROI and attribute conversions?
- What are your fees and what’s excluded?
- Can you provide client references?

Red flags
- Promises of guaranteed rankings or “#1 on Google”
- Vague deliverables or no case studies
- No clear reporting or no named team members
- Extremely low pricing that seems too good to be true

Ballpark costs (typical ranges)
- Local SEO: $500–$3,000+/month
- National SEO: $2,000–$10,000+/month
- PPC management: 10–20% of ad spend (or $500–$3,000/month management)
- Website design: $3,000–$75,000+ depending on scope
- Social management: $1,000–$6,000+/month

If you want, tell me the answers to the quick questions above (or your top priorities and budget) and I’ll recommend 3–5 St. Louis agencies that are a good match and explain why.
